feeds.title: Nostalgia Central Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the premier online guide to five decades of pop culture, television, music, movies, and social history. Whether you are looking for reference material or entertainment, if it's from the 1950s, 1960s, 1970s, 1980s, or 1990s you will find it here.

feeds.title: Vintage Everyday
feeds.description: Vintage Everyday is here to bring back some good & bad memories.

feeds.title: Retroist
feeds.description: I have always been a big fan of nostalgia. From an early age, I liked reading about and collecting things from the past. The Retroist is the digital expression of my appreciation for all of those things. My posts tend to jump around by decade. While I really enjoy stuff from the Seventies, Eighties, and Nineties, I enjoy occasionally taking a stroll in the deeper and more recent past.

feeds.title: Kitchen Nostalgia
feeds.description: I'm Z. Owner, creator, photographer, videographer, recipe developer, and web designer of Kitchen Nostalgia. Kitchen Nostalgia is a food blog about home cooking with a side of nostalgia. Every day I show my favorite tried and true family recipes. I would love you to post your favorite recipes too!

feeds.title: Dinosaur Dracula!
feeds.description: I'm Matt. Dinosaur Dracula is a series of tributes to things that thrill and excite me, or at least, things that used to thrill and excite me. This site celebrates the sheer joy of trivial things, from Halloween decorations to Ninja Turtles, to the pewter dolphin pendants sold in every aquarium's gift shop. Dinosaur Dracula is, if nothing else, my perpetual excuse to enjoy things I'm no longer 'supposed' to enjoy.

feeds.title: Glamour Daze
feeds.description: A lavishly illustrated archive and blog of vintage fashion and beauty, with gorgeous imagery, films, educational reading and pretty things to buy.

feeds.title: Planet Football » Nostalgia
feeds.description: Featuring tributes to some of football's greatest players from years gone by, plus celebrations of great teams of the past and many more great moments from the 1990s and 2000s. Planet Football is a celebration of everything that's great about football. We publish feature articles every day including in-depth interviews, football nostalgia - including football in the 1990s and football in the Noughties - and regular football quizzes.

feeds.title: The Edge » Nostalgic
feeds.description: The following section of The Edge features articles on Nostalgic news. The Edge is YOUR student union's official print and online entertainment magazine. We are your main source of information on when your favorite band is playing, local theatre or comedy performances, and features on recent releases in the theatre, TV, film, and music world.

feeds.title: Tasha Could Make That
feeds.description: Tasha is an everyday vintage gal. She's thoroughly modern, she just likes old stuff. Calling her a vintage enthusiast is probably an understatement. Saying she's obsessed with vintage is a little closer to the truth. She loves all sorts of vintage items from different eras, but her heart is with 1950s knitting and sewing patterns, and mid-century fashion, housewares, and furniture.

feeds.title: Fusionostalgia
feeds.description: Welcome to the music space of Fusionostalgia. Read articles on upcoming artists, new bands, singles, albums, and more.

feeds.title: The Dressed Aesthetic
feeds.description: The Dressed Aesthetic is a vintage fashion blog, with a focus on vintage and vintage-inspired clothing, wardrobe management, outfit planning, and sewing. A scientist by day & vintage huntress by night. Here I chronicle my daily outfits, musings, & inspirations.

feeds.title: Wave of Nostalgia Blog
feeds.description: Wave of Nostalgia's News & Events blog brings the bookstore to life—sharing curated stories, creative updates, author features, community happenings, and literary inspiration through an engaging, book-loving lens.

feeds.title: Plain and Fancy Girl » Nostalgia
feeds.description: Marian Beaman's Nostalgia category offers heartfelt reflections and memoir-style stories that weave together personal memories, family lore, and Mennonite heritage—delivering comforting, evocative glimpses into the past.

feeds.title: The Artyologist
feeds.description: The Artyologist is a vintage-inspired blog curated by Nicole, blending slow fashion, DIY projects, and zero-waste living with a nostalgic flair. Her content spans from upcycled fashion tutorials to reflections on sustainable living, all presented through a lens of vintage aesthetics. Nicole's work celebrates creativity, sustainability, and the timeless elegance of past eras.

feeds.title: Vintage Fashion Guild Blog
feeds.description: The VFG is an international organization dedicated to the promotion and preservation of vintage fashion

feeds.title: VintageReveries
feeds.description: Vintage Reveries' Editorial section offers a curated collection of vintage fashion photography, personal styling projects, and historical fashion insights, blending personal narratives with a passion for retro aesthetics.

feeds.title: Bleu Avenue
feeds.description: A fashion blog devoted to bringing you outfit inspiration and product review for the latest styles with something to suit all fashion tastes.

feeds.title: The Vintage Inn » Vintage Fashion
feeds.description: The Vintage Fashion section of The Vintage Inn offers a curated collection of vintage fashion blog posts from the 1920s to the 1960s, featuring personal style showcases, historical insights, and curated vintage finds.

feeds.title: Vintage Life
feeds.description: Sammy Davis is a passionate thrifter with 10+ years of experience buying 85% of her wardrobe secondhand. She founded Vintage Life also known as Sammy Davis Vintage, a vintage fashion blog, in 2009 to share the soul-inspiring benefits of wearing secondhand and vintage styles from the past.

feeds.title: Miss Amy May
feeds.description: I'm Miss Amy May, a vintage-style enthusiast who loves mid-century clothing, a knife-sharp eyeliner wing, and red lipstick. Having embraced the style during my mid-20s almost by accident, I've enjoyed documenting my style here and on Instagram as I've honed and developed it, and am always happy to give tips, tricks, and advice to any ladies new to the style wondering whether they can 'pull it off - to which my answer is always, 'yes, you can.'

feeds.title: Pleasant Family Shopping
feeds.description: Pleasant Family Shopping is a blog dedicated to preserving the history and reflecting on the nostalgia of the mid and late-20th-century shopping experience, as told through the stories of America's great retail chains - primarily discount stores, supermarkets, and department stores.

feeds.title: A Few Threads Loose
feeds.description: A Few Threads Loose started quite an by accident. I was raised in an antique shop and vintage has always been a big part of my life. This is a disorganized rambling of a vintage-loving amateur seamstress, experimental cook, military wife, and sometimes barista with a few threads lose.

feeds.title: Vintage Starlet
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lolita Haze. Thank you for joining me in the backstage look into my vintage life as an all-American Burlesque Stripper. Here I'll share with you my life of vintage beauty, fashion, sewing, homemaking, cinema, hobbies, pinup modeling, and of course the risque art of Burlesque.

feeds.title: Vintage in a Modern World
feeds.description: Hello, my name is Kate and I have a passion for sharing beauty tidbits from the past. I can often be found with my nose buried in an antique formula book, working out how to bring these historical beauty recipes to life. When not creating beauty products (cold cream, eyeshadows, hair tonics, etc), I love delving into the small and mundane things of everyday life for women around the turn of the century.

feeds.title: Platform Vintage Blog
feeds.description: Sustainable, Affordable, Vintage. Find all your vintage clothes at Platform Vintage. Our focus is on clothing from the 70s with a balance between our women's and men's clothing stock.

feeds.title: DoYouRemeber
feeds.description: Keep your memories alive with DYR's Nostalgia News. Stay informed and up-to-date on important topics, people, and pastimes from your generation. Our news coverage is tailored for nostalgia enthusiasts. Here you'll find stories you care about with subjects stemming from the '50s, '60s, '70s, and '80s.

feeds.title: Hemmings
feeds.description: Hemmings Motor News strives to enhance the experience of the collector-car enthusiast by publishing high-quality products while serving our readers and advertisers with excellence. Hemmings is the world's largest collector car marketplace and the world's premier live-online collector car auction.

feeds.title: The Vintage Inn
feeds.description: Vintage Inn focuses on vintage topics from the 1920s-to 1960s. With features on vintage Images, vintage Canadian History (fun and interesting topics), vintage lifestyle posts (hair, clothes, household items, events), vintage travel and so much more, you are guaranteed to find something of interest.

feeds.title: Nostalgic Warehouse Blog
feeds.description: The Nostalgic Warehouse blog features educational information, style Q&As, and featured home renovation projects from top interior designers. Founded in 1980 by an antique store owner, Nostalgic Warehouse has grown from a modest proprietorship to a flourishing company and a leading vintage door hardware manufacturer.

feeds.title: Glamour » Nostalgia
feeds.description: Find the latest about Nostalgia news, plus helpful articles, tips and tricks, and guides at Glamour.com. Glamour.com is your source for what matters to women now, from outfit ideas and makeup tutorials to celebrity news and politics.
